Forex, the broker and the platform
Orders, stop loss and take profit
On EURUSD you see a bid of 1.1000 and an ask of 1.1001. What is the 1-pip difference between them?
The spread, a cost you pay on every trade
The fixed commission the broker charges on withdrawals
The swap for holding the position overnight
The margin locked up as collateral
You buy at the ask and sell at the bid. The difference between them is the spread, the main cost of a trade. That's why every position starts slightly in the red.
What does a single candlestick on the H4 chart show?
The open, close, high and low of the price over a 4-hour period
The average price over the last 4 days
How many trades were made in the last 4 minutes
The direction the price will take over the next 4 hours
Each candlestick shows the open, close, high and low for a period. On H4, the period is 4 hours. A candlestick shows the past, not what comes next.
